turns.text: My hometown is Multan. It is very hot city in summer, and it is famous for mangoes and the shrines.
I was living there since my childhood, then I come to Karachi for my study in university.
The thing I miss most is my mother cooking. In Karachi the food is not same like home food.
Also in Multan life is more slow, people have more time. Here everybody is busy, busy all the time.
But I think in Karachi there is more opportunity for jobs, so I will stay here after my degree.
